player_preview_text: This is what learners see. Your attempts are trial runs: they are not counted and do not reach the gradebook.
player_preview_lesson: This is what learners see. Only they mark a page as done, so there is no mark for you.
player_forbidden_text: The course lessons and tasks open once you enroll. You can enroll on the course page.
player_not_found_text: This course has no such activity: it may have been removed, or the link is out of date.
player_empty: The teacher has not added material here yet.
player_opens_at: Opens {date}. Until then it is not available.
player_locked_text: This activity is not available to you.
player_hint_attempt: Questions come one at a time and answers save themselves: you can stop and continue later.
player_hint_code: The solution is checked automatically, and your code saves itself.
player_hint_submission: Upload your work files and submit them for the teacher to review.
player_certificate_pending: The certificate is issued once you complete the course.
player_out_of_attempts: No attempts are left. If you need a retake,
player_past_due_retake: The deadline has passed. If you need a retake,
player_ask_teacher: ask the teacher in the course discussions.
player_remediation_hint: Before another attempt, your teacher asks you to review the mistakes of the last one.
player_archived_text: The materials and your results stay readable. New attempts, hand-ins and marks are no longer accepted.
